packs.findings: CONTENT pass. The v2 rule is correct and complete for the items: drop silent e before a vowel ending; double after one short vowel + one consonant in a one-syllable word; never double w/x/y; consonant+y usually -> i before -es/-ed, kept before -ing; -es after s/x/sh/ch. The help steps match. All 24 items pass. SOURCE fail, but close: the three new sources resolve and are directly relevant. Their registered supports cover the silent-e drop, one-syllable doubling and y->i "generally, with exceptions" (the rule now says "usually", matching the source). They do not cover three clauses: never double w/x/y, keep y before -ing, and -es after s/x/sh/ch (tested by item 18). Live Language Portal pages could not be fetched in this pass (WebFetch socket closed), so support is judged against the registered `supports` text in sources.json only.
